wikipedia.extract: The sapayoa or broad-billed sapayoa (Sapayoa aenigma) is a suboscine passerine bird found Colombia, Ecuador, and Panama.
wikipedia.title: Sapayoa

wikipedia.extract: The Colombian woolly monkey (Lagothrix lagothricha lugens) is a critically endangered subspecies of the common woolly monkey from Colombia. It was initially thought to be a subspecies of the common woolly monkey (L. lagothricha), but was later reclassified as its own species.
wikipedia.title: Colombian woolly monkey

commonNames.name: Bornean White-bearded Gibbon
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Bornean white-bearded gibbon (Hylobates albibarbis), also known as the Bornean agile gibbon or southern gibbon, is a species of gibbon endemic to southern Borneo. It is an endangered species, due to the ongoing logging of tropical forests between the Kapuas and Barito rivers.
wikipedia.title: Bornean white-bearded gibbon

wikipedia.extract: Viridiplantae (New Latin for "green plants"), also known as kingdom Plantae sensu stricto ("plants in a narrow sense"), is a clade of mostly autotrophic eukaryotes that constitutes the largest group within the predominantly photosynthetic superclade Archaeplastida, with around half a million known species that include all green algae and land plants (embryophytes, which evolved from freshwater green algae known as streptophytes). They are important primary producers in both aquatic (marine and freshwater) and terrestrial ecosystems, and are significant contributors to the Earth's oxygen, carbon and water cycles.
wikipedia.title: Viridiplantae

wikipedia.extract: The blue-bellied parrot or purple-bellied parrot (Triclaria malachitacea) is the only species in its genus. It is generally considered endemic to the humid Atlantic Forest of southeastern Brazil, but there are two unconfirmed records from Misiones in Argentina.
wikipedia.title: Blue-bellied parrot

wikipedia.extract: The bird family Sulidae comprises the gannets and boobies. Collectively called sulids, they are medium-large coastal seabirds that plunge-dive for fish and similar prey.
wikipedia.title: Sulidae

wikipedia.extract: Neurospora crassa is a type of red bread mold of the phylum Ascomycota. The genus name, meaning 'nerve spore' in Greek, refers to the characteristic striations on the spores.
wikipedia.title: Neurospora crassa

wikipedia.extract: The Casuariiformes is an order of large flightless birds that has four surviving members: the three species of cassowary, and the only remaining species of emu. All four are placed in a single family, Casuariidae.
wikipedia.title: Casuariiformes

wikipedia.extract: The black-tailed godwit (Limosa limosa) is a large, long-legged, long-billed shorebird first described by Carl Linnaeus in 1758. It is a member of the godwit genus, Limosa.
wikipedia.title: Black-tailed godwit

wikipedia.extract: The tityras are passerine birds in the genus Tityra in the family Tityridae. They are found from southern Mexico, through Central America, to northern and central South America, including Trinidad.
wikipedia.title: Tityra

wikipedia.extract: Bustards, including floricans and korhaans, are large, terrestrial birds living mainly in dry grassland areas and in steppe regions. They range in length from 40 to 150 cm (16 to 59 in).
wikipedia.title: Bustard

wikipedia.extract: Phalacrocoracidae is a family of approximately 40 species of aquatic birds found worldwide and commonly known as cormorants and shags. Several different classifications of the family have been proposed, but in 2021 the International Ornithologists' Union (IOU) adopted a consensus taxonomy of seven genera.
wikipedia.title: Cormorant

commonNames.name: Hernández-Camacho’s Night Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Hernández-Camacho's night monkey (Aotus jorgehernandezi) is a species of night monkey of the family Aotidae. It was first described in 2007 by Thomas Defler and Marta Bueno.
wikipedia.title: Hernández-Camacho's night monkey

wikipedia.extract: Proconsulidae is an early family of primates that lived during the Miocene epoch in Kenya, and was restricted to Africa. Members of the family have a mixture of Old World monkey and ape characteristics, so the placement in the ape superfamily Hominoidea is tentative; some scientists place Proconsulidae outside of Hominoidea in a separate superfamily Proconsuloidea, before the split of the apes and Old World monkeys.
wikipedia.title: Proconsulidae

wikipedia.extract: The Pelagornithidae, commonly called pelagornithids, pseudodontorns, bony-toothed birds, false-toothed birds or pseudotooth birds, are a prehistoric family of large seabirds. Their fossil remains have been found all over the world in rocks dating between the Early Paleocene and the Pliocene-Pleistocene boundary.
wikipedia.title: Pelagornithidae
